parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "conversationId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.conversationId }}",
  "tenantId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.tenantId }}",
  "customerId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.customerId }}",
  "channel": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.channel }}",
  "instruction": "Summarize the conversation in 3-5 sentences. Then extract key facts (e.g., product interests, preferences, complaints) and explicit preferences (e.g., language, contact channel, time). Return JSON: { \"summary\": string, \"facts\": [{key, value}], \"preferences\": [{key, value}] }.",
  "triggeredBy": "n8n/conversation-summarization"
}

={
  "type": "SUMMARY",
  "scope": "CUSTOMER",
  "entityId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.customerId }}",
  "tenantId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.tenantId }}",
  "key": "conversation_summary_{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.conversationId }}",
  "value": "{{ $json.data.summary || $json.summary }}",
  "expiresAt": "{{ $now.plus({ days: 90 }).toISO() }}",
  "metadata": {
    "conversationId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.conversationId }}",
    "channel": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.channel }}",
    "workflow": "conversation-summarization"
  }
}

={
  "source": "AI_CONVERSATION_SUMMARY",
  "conversationId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.conversationId }}",
  "tenantId": "{{ $('Code: Prep Conversation').item.json.tenantId }}",
  "summary": "{{ $('AI: Summarize Conversation').item.json.data.summary || $('AI: Summarize Conversation').item.json.summary }}",
  "extractedAt": "{{ $now.toISO() }}",
  "updatedBy": "n8n/conversation-summarization"
}
